sources.notes: Official HSBC page checked 2026-10-02: $495 annual fee; 75,000 bonus points after $4,000 in 3 months; 5x eligible travel, 2x dining and other travel, 1x other; Global Entry/TSA PreCheck/CLEAR/NEXUS credit up to $120 every 4.5 years.

notes: HSBC Elite has a $495 annual fee with benefits worth over $2,900 in the first year and $2,000 annually thereafter (per HSBC). Requires HSBC Premier banking relationship to apply. No foreign transaction fees. LoungeKey access with PPS (Priority Pass Select). Strong travel insurance package.

recurring_credits.name: Global Entry Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $120 credit for Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, CLEAR or NEXUS, once every 4.5 years.
